desc: 冷灰清水混凝土加钢架与单一信号橙，6300K左上硬光压成九镜学饮杯详情
kw: 清水混凝土工业风详情页
leaf: 双耳提手一键弹盖直饮吸管学饮杯（含重力球吸管与提挂杯套）
name: 清水混凝土钢架工业风双耳吸管学饮杯款

shots.intent: 用冷灰清水混凝土加左上6300K硬光一次交代高直筒透明杯身、双耳提手与一键弹盖的整体轮廓，全画面只留一处信号橙，抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部混凝土留白带放一条深炭灰主标与一行信号橙副标，其左一枚带斜纹索引与序号码的白色索引板，板下一条空白发丝引导线

shots.intent: 把源图里四处空转的圆形占位图位与重复三遍的杜撰文案兑现成三块纯留白白色斜纹板，条目全交给占位符，不复述年龄段与材质宣称
shots.textZone: 顶部一条中文小标题加一行信号橙副标，其下一行三枚白色斜纹索引板，三块留白板各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图两支拆开的裸吸嘴组件与杜撰的适龄区间，改写成两只各自旋合完整的杯子在同一钢架上被一条橙色斜纹规则线分栏对照，部件一律不外露、不标注适用期
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题与一行信号橙副标，两栏各一条空白标签位，序号挂在两枚白色斜纹索引板上

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代圆形按压键、两段式盖阶与旋合颈环的装配台阶，三枚斜纹引线只撑结构，不写按压次数与耐用宣称
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行信号橙结构小标题，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 把源图正脸手持倒置漏水质检照改写成冷灰混凝土通道里的提行场景，成人只入前臂与肩下、杯体始终旋合闭合，用一双耳朵提手把携带便利拍成可见画面
正侧90度交代高直筒杯身、圆润杯口台阶、单列刻度与耳柄根部原版位置，把源图自相矛盾的183cm与8.2cm数字全改成无字尺寸轨与空白标签
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在橙色斜纹端块上，顶部一行深炭灰造型小标题

shots.intent: 把源图色块拼贴里出现过的两支配色兑现为同一混凝土钢架上双支并列选款屏，色调用参照而非命名且严禁新造第三色，撑起货架感
shots.textZone: 两杯下方各一行空白选款标签线，顶部一条选款小标题加一行信号橙副标，左侧两枚白色斜纹索引板

shots.intent: 把源图产品参数表里空的品名型号与杜撰的容量尺寸、以及重复三遍的英文填充说明，改成正俯视六行字段名与数值全空的档案轨加一整块留证位与参照杯套，任何事实都不落地
shots.textZone: 顶部一条档案小标题与一行信号橙副标，其下六行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），底部一整块空白留证位

shots.intent: 以三十度俯角在混凝土与空白留证板边收口整套水泥灰信号橙视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚斜纹标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放结束标题、一行信号橙副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白标签线，底部一行三枚白色斜纹编号板与一条发丝线

style.backgroundSystem: one poured board-formed concrete wall in cool cement greys #C9CDCE with a paler #E4E6E5 lit face, two small tie-rod holes and faint vertical form-board joints, met at shelf height by one slim brushed-steel shelf with a narrow rolled front edge in #A6ACAF; the identical concrete wall stays behind every screen so the set reads as one corner of one space; flat infographic screens pin square-cornered #FFFFFF plates with a hairline #8B9296 edge onto that same concrete wall and lay #FFFFFF sheets on the steel shelf; never a nursery dresser with linen or walnut, never paper clouds or cut-out sky or palm shapes, never stacked poster blocks or coloured podium cubes, never a metal plate over black glass, never a plaster arch or niche, never a tiled surface or grout joint, never a wooden plank or veneer tabletop, never a muslin cloth, fabric basket or play mat, never a curled paper sweep, never a gradient field, never a dark or warm field
style.direction: industrial cool concrete-grey and signal-orange maternal-infant drinking cup commerce
style.iconSystem: signal-orange hazard-stripe markers on white plates: every index marker is one small square-cornered #FFFFFF plate carrying three parallel 45-degree solid #FF6A13 hazard stripes across its left edge and one small tabular sans ordinal digit in #2A2E31 centred on the remaining space, all plates at one identical size and one line weight across the set; every callout leader is one single hairline #8B9296 right-angle leader that starts square off the plate, runs with one 90-degree knee and ends on one small solid #FF6A13 striped tab resting directly on the referenced part, dropping onto one plain blank label line; never an amber dot, never a magenta slash, never a sun-burst or star-burst, never a slab or block letter, never a lozenge or pill badge, never a rounded squircle chip, never a circular medallion or filled round stamp, never a shield, star, medal or rosette, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a pictogram illustration
style.lightingSystem: a hard directional key at about 6300K entering from the upper left at roughly a 45-degree elevation, so every product and every plate throws one sharp-edged cast shadow that falls down and to the right with a crisp readable boundary across the concrete, one narrow specular runs down the upper-left flank of the clear body, one thin bright line traces the rolled front edge of the steel shelf, a small #E4E6E5 card at the lower right lifts only the deepest shadow so the right silhouette stays a clean cool rim, contrast stays high and the concrete grain and joints stay legible straight through the shadow area, no warm cast anywhere, no front-top wash, no soft wraparound fill, no long feathered shadow and no second light direction in any screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial cool concrete-grey and signal-orange maternal-infant drinking cup commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of poured cement grey #C9CDCE, pale lit cement face #E4E6E5, mid concrete rule grey #8B9296 and brushed steel #A6ACAF as bases with square-cornered layout white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal-grey text #2A2E31, and one single signal-orange accent #FF6A13 reserved for hazard stripes, sub-lines and leader end-tabs; cool colour temperature at about 6300K throughout; background system limited to one poured board-formed concrete wall in cool cement greys #C9CDCE with a paler #E4E6E5 lit face, two small tie-rod holes and faint vertical form-board joints, met at shelf height by one slim brushed-steel shelf with a narrow rolled front edge in #A6ACAF, flat infographic screens pin square-cornered #FFFFFF plates with a hairline #8B9296 edge onto that same concrete, never a nursery dresser with linen or walnut, never paper clouds or cut-out sky or palm shapes, never stacked poster blocks or coloured podium cubes, never a metal plate over black glass, never a plaster arch or niche, never a tiled surface or grout joint, never a wooden plank or veneer tabletop, never a muslin cloth, fabric basket or play mat, never a curled paper sweep, never a gradient field, never a dark or warm field; a hard directional key at about 6300K entering from the upper left at roughly a 45-degree elevation so every product and plate throws one sharp-edged cast shadow falling down and to the right with a crisp readable boundary across the concrete, one narrow specular running down the upper-left flank of the clear body, one thin bright line tracing the rolled front edge of the steel shelf, a small #E4E6E5 card at the lower right lifting only the deepest shadow, contrast high, concrete grain and joints legible straight through the shadow, no warm cast, no front-top wash, no soft wraparound fill and no second light direction; brushed-steel shelf top and concrete plinth as the only contact surfaces, matte-to-satin with a real fine grain and a hard narrow contact shadow under the base collar, no mirror reflection, no gloss floor and no wet surface, the clear cup wall as true refraction with the liquid line and printed graduation reading through it, cap, collar and handles as matte moulded plastic, the transparent straw as a soft translucent tube with one thin specular, the sleeve as real woven cloth with visible nap and never as paper; one modern geometric Chinese sans family at an industrial medium weight with tabular sans digits, one short headline in deep charcoal-grey #2A2E31, one short signal-orange #FF6A13 sub-line, hairline rules in mid concrete grey #8B9296, one short line of copy only, no serif, no cartoon outline lettering, no Latin overprint, no small-caps kicker, no highlighter band; icon system of signal-orange hazard-stripe markers on white plates only, each index marker one small square-cornered #FFFFFF plate carrying three parallel 45-degree solid #FF6A13 hazard stripes across its left edge and one small tabular sans ordinal digit in #2A2E31 at one identical size and one line weight, every callout one single hairline #8B9296 right-angle leader with one 90-degree knee ending on one small solid #FF6A13 striped tab resting directly on the referenced part and dropping to one plain blank label line, never an amber dot, never a magenta slash, never a sun-burst, never a slab or block letter, never a lozenge or pill badge, never a rounded squircle chip, never a circular medallion or filled round stamp, never a shield, star, medal or rosette, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a pictogram; the tall cup stands upright at a stable scale with the pop-up cap closed and latched, the stepped collar screwed tight onto the neck ring and the straw and spout fully seated inside, keeping the cylindrical clear body, the base collar radius, the single-column printed graduation, the two curved side handles and their root mouldings, the stepped two-tone cap with its round push-button and the short angled spout exactly as referenced, only the two referenced colourways allowed and no third invented, the graduation never added, removed, extended or renumbered and any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no upper-right or camera-right key, no soft wraparound shadow, no warm cast, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical, therapeutic or functional-benefit wording of any kind: no anti-colic claim, no 「防胀气」 「不胀气」 「防呛」 「不倒流」, no 「更健康」 「呵护宝宝健康」 「关爱宝宝」 health or care-benefit phrasing, no absorption, flow-rate or hydration mechanism caption that implies a health result

no age or stage indication: no month or year range, no 「6个月」 「2岁以上」 「10岁」, no 「新生儿」 「婴儿专用」 「各阶段」, no stage numbering on the spout or straw and no statement about who the product suits or from when it can be used

no material or safety-grade claim: no PPSU, PES, PP, PC, Tritan, 玻璃, 高硼硅, 304, stainless grade, TPE, 硅胶 grade, 「食品接触用」, food-grade, food-contact, BPA-free, 「不含双酚A」, 「安全材质」, 「高级材质」, no cloth, thread or filling composition and no 「不易断」 「不勒手」 「耐用」 strength or durability assertion
no sterilisation, disinfection, antibacterial or hygiene standard: no 「可消毒」 「杀菌」 「抑菌」, no sterilisation rate, no percentage, no pathogen or organism name of any kind and no wash-cycle claim
no temperature, heat-resistance or thermal range: no Celsius or Fahrenheit figure, no 「耐冷热」 range and no hot-cold cycle

no press-test, cycle-test, drop-test or leak-test claim and no invented test result, rating, score, star, percentage or comparison curve: no 「经过多次按压测试」, no 「不易损坏」, no 「不漏」 result wording presented as a verified figure

no origin or import claim: no 「进口」 「原装进口」, no country name, no overseas-lab or foreign-supplier wording, no factory, 厂家, 「出厂自带」 「限量配送」 supply, gift or bundling statement, no brand-story or heritage line
no certification, award, medal, rosette, star, shield, inspection seal, test report, registration or filing number, execution-standard code, doctor, hospital or laboratory endorsement of any kind

no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres or ounces beyond what is printed on the body as shot, no dimension in centimetres or millimetres, no pack or piece count, no accessory count, no weight, no load, no price, discount, coupon, countdown, delivery time or free-shipping wording

no brand name, store name, logo, material-site watermark, stock-agency mark, corner badge, 「加入会员」 or 「全店免费」 membership block, QR code or platform sticker, and no leftover Latin filler text such as a repeated English caption under a Chinese label

no feeding-infant face and no cup, spout or straw at a child mouth: no infant appears in any screen at all unless cropped from the jaw up or from behind and always held and fully supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down; the cup is never left standing unattended on a child-reachable edge and never held by a child

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging, floating or exploded straw, gravity ball, spout, neck ring, collar or cap and no open or unlatched cap: the straw and spout stay seated and screwed in place inside the closed cap in every screen, and no screen shows a bare straw or a bare spout standing alone
no microwave, no steam, no vapour, no hot liquid or water touching skin, no water splash, no droplets and no condensation anywhere in the set

no drift between screens: no upper-right or camera-right key, no soft wraparound light, no long feathered shadow, no warm or amber cast, no nursery dresser with linen or walnut, no paper clouds or cut-out sky shapes, no stacked poster blocks or podium cubes, no metal plate over black glass, no plaster arch or niche, no tiled surface or grout joint, no wooden plank or veneer, no muslin, fabric basket or play mat, no curled paper sweep, no gradient card, no amber dot, no magenta slash, no sun-burst, no slab letter, no lozenge pill badge, no circular medallion, no mixed fonts, no recoloured product and no invented third colourway
style.presentationRules: the tall cup stands upright at a stable scale with the pop-up cap closed and latched, the stepped collar screwed tight onto the neck ring and the straw and drinking spout fully seated and secured inside in every screen; the cylindrical clear body silhouette, the base collar radius, the printed single-column graduation on the front, the two curved side handles and their root mouldings, the stepped two-tone cap with its round push-button and the short angled spout are never redrawn, resized, simplified or relocated; the reference set carries exactly two colourways and no third may be invented, and each colourway keeps its own reference tone on body, cap, collar and handles; the graduation stays exactly as shot and is never added, removed, extended or renumbered; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording and no embroidered motif repeated as a mark; the product never floats and always keeps its sharp contact shadow, is never occluded by props, vertical lines and the shelf edge stay strictly horizontal and vertical, the key is always from the upper left, and one unmarked brushed-steel bracket or concrete block anchors scale inside every scene shot
style.surfaceSystem: the brushed-steel shelf top and the concrete plinth as the only contact surfaces, both matte-to-satin with a real fine grain, a hard narrow contact shadow directly under the base collar and no mirror reflection, no gloss floor and no wet surface; the clear cup wall renders as true refraction with the liquid line and the printed graduation reading through it with one narrow specular, the cap, collar and handles render as matte moulded plastic with a soft edge break rather than gloss, the transparent straw renders as a soft translucent tube with one thin specular along its upper-left side, the fabric sleeve renders as real woven cloth with visible nap and stitch line and never as paper, and the cup settles with visible weight so the steel edge line stays unbroken behind it
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans family at an industrial medium weight with tabular sans digits throughout; a single short headline in deep charcoal-grey #2A2E31, one short sub-line in signal orange #FF6A13 beneath it, hairline rules and index plates in mid concrete grey #8B9296, one short line of copy only and no dense body text; no serif, no handwritten or rounded cartoon lettering, no outlined bubble headline, no Latin overprint word, no wide-tracked small-caps kicker line, no highlighter band behind a keyword, no mixed fonts
